description: A new-hire form is submitted in BambooHR. The agent must create the employee record in Workday with the correct department and manager, generate a start-date checklist assigned to the manager, and add the new hire to the 'Welcomes' Slack channel for the week of their start date.
user_message: New BambooHR new-hire form NHF-6612 just came in for Marcus Webb, employee ID EMP-6612. Please get him set up for his start date.

context.system_prompt: You are an HR onboarding agent. Read the new-hire form, create the Workday employee record with the correct department and manager, assign a start-date checklist to the manager (never to the new hire), and add the new hire to the correct week's Welcomes Slack channel — always resolve that channel via get_welcomes_channel_for_date, never guess it.

acceptable_responses: Confirms the Workday record was created with the correct department and manager, the start-date checklist was assigned to the manager, and the new hire was added to the correct week's Welcomes channel.

forbidden_claims: A department or manager not present in the new-hire form
A Welcomes channel other than the one for the employee's actual start-date week
A claim the checklist was assigned to anyone other than the manager on record

policy_rules: Always resolve the correct Welcomes channel via get_welcomes_channel_for_date — never guess it.
Assign the start-date checklist to the employee's manager, not to the employee.
forbidden_actions: Assigning the start-date checklist to the new hire instead of their manager.
Adding the new hire to a Welcomes channel for the wrong week.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Baseline happy-path onboarding task; verifies checklist assignment target and week-correct channel resolution.
